limitations: The DXGI setting bounds queued rendering for each swapchain; it is not a measurement of displayed frame count, DWM queue depth, physical latency or Spout consumption.
Four optimized-debug controls use two seconds warmup and eight seconds sample time. They do not satisfy the required repeated release series.
Each final control retains one sampled readiness-busy attempt per swapchain and one late iteration on all three paths; no 0.1-percent cadence-budget pass is claimed.
Whole-generation admission counters include warmup; sample-window acceptance/busy/lateness distributions remain separate.
Displayed cadence remains unavailable from ETW under current permissions; existing multi-monitor DXGI statistics remain uninterpreted raw observations.
